bio: Sip Social started with a simple idea: the best part of a good event is the moment you stop, take a breath, and have a proper coffee with someone. Most events don't have that moment built in — there's a buffet, maybe a bar, but rarely a café.
I set out to change that. Every drink is made properly, to order, by a trained barista — because an event full of people deserves better than instant coffee from an urn.

Since then it's grown into a fully mobile set-up, equipped and insured, that travels to weddings, office days, launches and parties. Whatever the occasion, the goal is the same one I started with — bring your favourite café to you, and make people's day a little better, one sip at a time.

features.title: Anywhere in the UK
features.body: We travel to you — no venue is too far.

features.title: Barista-grade kit
features.body: Proper machine, grinder and everything in between.

features.title: Covered on-site
features.body: Public liability cover, details on request for your venue.

faqs.a: Sip Social is fully mobile and takes bookings across the UK — tell us your location and we'll confirm availability.

faqs.q: Can I see you in action before booking?
faqs.a: Keep an eye on our Instagram for upcoming pop-ups, or ask when you enquire — we're happy to point you to photos and feedback from recent events.
